messages:
Olivia: Hey team — planning the social push for next Friday launch. Need hero still, 1:1 crop, two caption tracks (benchmark vs developer), UTMs, and three micro-replies per track. Can we land assets + copy by EOD?
Marcus: Uploading hero_16x9_v4.png and hero_1x1_v3.png to s3://redwood-marketing/launch/1799993333/ now. Also adding a 7s loop MP4 and a tiny GIF fallback.
Jin: I'll draft copy. Variant A (benchmark): lead with latency/cost wins. Variant B (developer): lead with SDK + quickstart. Will prepare both X-length and longer LinkedIn versions.
PublishBot: Reserved slot Fri 08:00-11:00 PT. No conflicts detected.
Olivia: Webinar CTA to use: "Save your seat" -> redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=launch_1799. HubSpot form -> list `launch_1799_social`. Webhook to #leads-launch required.
Marcus: Assets uploaded and README updated (alt text, dimensions, sizes). GIF fallback named teaser_fallback.gif.
Jin: Draft micro-replies (benchmark):
- A1: "Which workload was that on?"
- A2: "Nice numbers — can you drop the config?"
- A3: "Want a quick demo clip?"
Draft micro-replies (developer):
- B1: "How long to integrate end-to-end?"
- B2: "Any SDK samples?"
- B3: "Hosted or self-hosted?"
Olivia: For X: pin the webinar CTA in the first reply and shorten replies (drop articles). Add hashtags: #inference #llm #redwood for LinkedIn.
PublishBot: Queue placed on HOLD until Olivia approves. Will release at scheduled times after sign-off.
LeadBot: HubSpot mapping verified: form `hs_1799` -> list `launch_1799_social`. Tagging rule `source:social_launch_1799` added. Webhook to `#leads-launch` verified.
Marcus: All assets good from my side.
Jin: Final copy posted here at 15:40 PT. Compressed X replies to fit thread flow.
Olivia: Approved — PublishBot, release at scheduled times. After publish we'll monitor first 45 minutes and seed retargeting if CTR < 1.2%. SDRs on standby in #leads-launch.
